name: conn_stack
display: Board-stacking interconnects (board-to-board, mezzanine, card-edge, pogo pin, headers, blade contacts)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-08-23. The existing conn_wire_board recipe covers only harness (wire-to-board) parts, and board-to-board was deliberately skipped when Marcus standardized on Hirose BM24. This recipe exists for the opposite problem: finding the HIGHEST-current stacking interconnect available, signals irrelevant. It therefore sweeps every family that can physically join two parallel PCBs and carry power: mezzanine/board-to-board, backplane, card-edge/edgeboard, pogo-pin spring probes, plain pin/female headers (a 2.54mm header stack is a legitimate power path), blade/shrapnel spring contacts, Micro-Match, and PCB welding terminals. Current coverage is patchy in the mezzanine/pogo buckets (~10-40%) and good in the header buckets (~50-60%) - a current filter silently drops every part that never published a rating, so always cross-check the raw attrs and the datasheet on finalists.

category_match.subcategory: Board-To-Board|Backplane|Mezzanine|Edgeboard|Card Edge|Pogo Pin|Pin Header|Female Header|Blade / Shrapnel|Micro-Match|PCB Welding Terminal

columns: __comment_current__: THE column this recipe exists for. '(Max)' alias must come
first: the bare 'Current Rating' alias substring-matches 'Current Rating (Max)'
and would shadow it.
__comment_current_trap__: LCSC CONFLATES per-contact and whole-connector ratings
in this one field, and the high end of the sort order is where the fakes live.
Verified against datasheets 2026-08-23:
Panasonic AXK5S20347YG  listed 10A   = 0.5A/contact x 20 contacts (TOTAL)
TE 2-5767004-2 (MICTOR) listed 11.5A = a signal connector's TOTAL, not power
Molex 757571401         listed 17A   = MX150, a sealed WIRE-to-board part
TE 2204585-4 (ELCON Mini) 35A/contact but CABLE-to-board, no board-mating half
Real per-contact winners that survived: Hirose BM50 15A, Amphenol PowerStak 20A.
NEVER quote a number out of this column without opening the PDF.
__comment_current_desc__: from_description is ON because whole vendor families
(notably the Xinyangze pogo pins, where the 10A parts live) publish EMPTY
attribute dicts and state the rating only in the description string. Verified
2026-08-23: the fallback adds ~2600 parts and the current parser only fires on
<number>A tokens, so temperature/pitch/voltage fields in those descriptions do
not pollute it. Cross-check any description-sourced number against the PDF.
__comment_height__: the mated stack gap. Different families name it differently;
'System Fit Height' (mezzanine) and 'Operational Height' (pogo) are the mated
numbers, 'Height Above Board' / 'Body Height' are unmated single-part heights.
__comment_smd__: same LCSC vocabulary as conn_wire_board - 'Standing/Sinking
paste' and 'Vertical welding' are SMD, 'Plugin'/'Direct Insert' are THT.
Ternary: silence stays NULL rather than asserting THT.
